name: No Download
description: Games that run entirely in the browser with nothing to install — no launcher, no plugin and no setup file. Open the page and play.

name: Single Player
description: Games designed to be played alone against the game itself, with no opponent, no lobby and no need for anyone else to be online.

name: Two Player
description: Local multiplayer games for two people sharing one keyboard or one touchscreen, with split controls listed on every game page.

name: Mobile Friendly
description: Games with working touch controls that have been checked on a phone-sized screen, including swipe gestures and on-screen buttons.

name: Keyboard Only
description: Games controlled entirely from the keyboard with no mouse required, which also makes them easier to play on a laptop trackpad.

name: Works Offline
description: Games that keep working after the page has loaded even if your connection drops, because all the game logic runs in your browser.

name: Open Source
description: Games whose source code is publicly available under a permissive licence, with a link to the original repository on every page.

name: Quick Session
description: Games where a full round takes under five minutes, making them the right choice for a coffee break rather than an evening.

name: Long Session
description: Games built for extended play, where progress accumulates over half an hour or more and stopping early costs you something.

name: Number Puzzle
description: Puzzles built around arithmetic, sequences or numeric targets, where the challenge is calculation and planning rather than reflexes.

name: Merge
description: Games where combining two identical pieces produces a bigger one, creating a chain of upgrades that drives the whole scoring system.

name: Falling Blocks
description: Stacking games where pieces descend from the top of the playfield and you rotate and position them before they land.

name: Word Guessing
description: Games where you deduce a hidden word from feedback given after each attempt, narrowing the possibilities with every guess.

name: Logic
description: Puzzles solved by deduction rather than speed, where every move follows from information already visible on the board. Rewarding for thinkers.

name: High Score
description: Games with no ending, only a number — you play until you lose and the goal is beating your previous best. A personal-best chase keeps every run meaningful.

name: Retro
description: Games in the visual and mechanical style of arcade and early home-computer classics, rebuilt to run in a modern browser.

name: Relaxing
description: Games with no timer, no failure state and no pressure, suitable for playing while thinking about something else entirely.

name: Brain Training
description: Games that exercise memory, pattern recognition or spatial reasoning, and that get measurably easier the more you play them.

name: Daily Puzzle
description: Games offering one fresh puzzle per day on a fixed reset schedule, shared by everyone playing on the same date.

name: Strategy
description: Games where planning several moves ahead matters more than execution, and where a bad decision costs you many turns later.

name: Classic
description: Games that have been played for decades and remain popular, with rules most people already half-remember from somewhere.

name: One Button
description: Games controlled with a single key or tap, which makes them instantly playable and surprisingly hard to actually master.

name: Endless
description: Games with no final level or win condition that continue escalating for as long as you can keep up with them.

name: Saves Progress
description: Games that store your board state or best score in browser local storage, so closing the tab does not lose your run.

name: No Sign-Up
description: Games you can play immediately with no account, no email address and no login wall standing between you and the first move.

name: Family Friendly
description: Games with no violence, no chat with strangers and no content that needs a parent to check it before a child plays. Safe for the whole family.
